brgyan te/ shing rta lnga brgya yang brgyan nas thams cad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la rim gro dang zham ring ①bya ba'i phyir phul te/rigs kyi bu bdag ni g.yog mo 'di dag 'bul zhing shing rta lnga brgya 'di dag kyang yongs su longs spyad ②pa'i phyir khyod la 'bul lo/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis rigs kyi bu de la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag gis 'byor pa thams cad yongs su gtang ②bar bya'o/ /yongs su gtong ba'i sems de lta bus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rjorgya'o / /de ltar na chos smra ba dag la mchod pa byas nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang thabs mkhas pa nyan nus te rigs kyi bu sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na 'di lta bu'i tshul dang 'di lta bu'i gtong ba la gnas nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang thabs mkhas pa yongs su dris sol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya po de dag dang shing rta lnga brgya po de dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bkang ba'i duphyir blangs te blangs nas rigs kyi bu rtag tu ngu la slar byin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags stan las langs te bdag gi stikhyim du zhugs pa dang nyi ma nub par gyur to/ /33—672

de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'di snyam du ①'di ltar bdag chos 'dod pa'i phyir 'ongs la 'dug pa'am nyal bar byed pa ni bdag gi mi cha la 'di ni ma legs kyis ②byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags bdag gzung ba'i phyir 'di lta ste chos ston du phyir ma byung gi bar du bdag 'greng ba dang 'chag pa'i spyod lam gnyis kyis dus 'da' bar bya'o zhes sems par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags lo bdun gyi bar du ting nge 'dzin gcig la snyoms par zhugs par gyur cing byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin stong phrag gzhal du med grangs med pa dag dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang thabs mkhas pa las byung ba la gnas par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu yang lo bdun gyi bar du gnyid dang rmugs pa med par spyod lam rnam pa gnyis kyis dus 'da' bar byed de/ lo bdun gyi bar du 'dod pa'i rtog pa ma byung / gnod sems kyi rtog pa ma byung / rnam par 'tshe ba'i rtog pa ma byung / ro la brkam pa ma yin sems kyi rnam par rtog pa ma byung ste/gzhan du na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags ting nge 'dzin las nam ldang bar 'gyur/ bdag cag gis kyang khri gang la rigs kyi bu de 'dug nas chos ston par 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi chos kyi khri bsham na ②bdag gis sa phyogs 'di chag chag ma btab kyisaX/ sa phyogs gang du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang thabs mkhas pa rab tu ston pa ⑤'gyur ba der legs par byug par bya me tog sna tshogs mngon par dgram mo snyam 33—673

mo / /tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya ①de dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'i rjes su slob cing spyod lam gnyis kyis dus 'da' bar ②byed de/ bya ba thams cad kyang de'i rjes su 'jug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus lha'i sgra dag las byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags da ②ste zhag bdun na ting nge 'dzin 'di las ldang ste langs nas grong khyer gyi dbus su 'dug ste chos ston par 'gyur ro zhes thos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus lha'i sgra de thos pa dang / dga' mgu yi durangs rab tu dga' mgu zhing bde ba dang / yid bde ba skyes te/ tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu sa phyogs de phyags nas chos kyi khri rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin bshams so/ /de nas bu mo de dag gis ⑤rang rang gi bla gos lus las phud de bla gos lnga brgya po de dag stan gang la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags 'dug nas chos ston par 'gyur ba der bting ngo / /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen ༅po chos 'phags kyi chos kyi stan bshams pa la bu mo de dag thams cad dga' mgu yi ⑦rangs rab tu dga' zhing mgu ba dang / yid bde ba skyes par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus phyogs der chag chag gdab par 'dod na/ ci nas kyang bdud sdig can gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu de chu ma rnyed nas sems mi dga' zhing sdug bsngal te/ yid mi bde bar gyur cing / sems gzhan du 'gyur ba dang /gang gis de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba nub par 'gyur ba dang / mchod pa de yang mi 33—674

mdzes par bya ba'i phyir gang gis sa phyogs der chag chag 'debs pa'i chu de ①thams cad kyang mi snang ba nyid du byas pas kun tu chu btsal na ②ma rnyed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'di snyam du ma la bdag gi lus phug la khrag gis sa phyogs 'di chag chag gdab bo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sa phyogs 'di ni rdul che ste sa phyogs 'di nas rdul gyi khams byung bas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyi lus la phog na mi rung gis ①bdag gi ④lus gdon mi za bar 'jig pa'i chos can 'dis ci zhig bya/bdag gi lus 'di lta bu'i bya ba la zhig pa ni sla'i dunas pa med pa'i bya ba la 'dod pa'i rgyu dang 'dod pa'i gzhis yang dang yang du 'khor bar 'khor zhing /bdag gi lus stong phrag mang po de lta bu'i gnas su zhig pa ni 'di lta bu'i gnas sam / chos yongs su gzung ba'i phyir ni ma yin te/ 'dod pa de lta bu'i chos can la zhig pa yin no snyam du bsams so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus de ltar bsams nas mtshon rnon po blangs te/bdag gi lus kun tu phug nas rang gi khrag gis sa phyogs de thams cad du chag chag btab bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'i rjes su slob pa tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa bu mo lnga brgya ⑥de dag thams cad kyis kyang mtshon rnon po blangs te/ rang rang gi lus phug nas rang rang gi khrag gis sa phyogs de ④thams cad du chag chag btab ste/ nide dag la bdud sdig can des dge ba'i rtsa ba'i bar chad bya ba'i glags gang du rnyed par 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu dang bu mo de dag thams cad sems gzhan du gyur pa med do/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du 33—675

sems te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'di tsam du chos 'dod pa dang / ci tsam du yi dam la brtan pa dang / ci tsam du go cha chen po bgos pa dang / lus dang srog dang longs spyod rnams la mi lta ba dang /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rtogs par bya ba'i phyir 'di lta ste/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yongs su dpag tu med pa las sems can thams cad thar bar bya'o snyam du lhag pa'i bsam pa la rdzizhugs pa ni ngo mtshar to snyam mo/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis khrag de dag thams cad lha'i tsan dan gyi ②chur byin gyis brlabs te/ lha'i tsan dan gyi chu ②dri dam pa rgya che ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa de'i dris sa phyogs de kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad lnga brgya tshang bar duyongs su khyab bo/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces / rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyi ⑤brtson 'grus bsam gyis mi khyab pa legs sodu/ /khyod kyi ④chos 'dod pa dang chos yongs su tshol ba yang legs te/ rigs kyi bu sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis kyang lhag pa'i bsam pa 'di lta bu dang / brtson 'grus 'di lta bu dang / chos 'dod pa 'di lta bus bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs so zhes smras so//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu 'di snyam du sems te / bdag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags kyis nichos kyi stan ni bting sa phyogs 'di phyag dar ni legs par byas chag 33—676

chag ni legs par btab na bdag gis me tog gang dag gis sa phyogs 'dir ①gtor bar bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags chos 'chad cing chos kyi stan la 'dug pa la gtor bar bya ba'i me tog de dag gang nas rnyed par 'gyur snyam mo/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu la 'di skad ces/rigs kyi bu lha'i me tog man dā ra ba 'di dag long ②la khyod kyis sa phyogs 'di dag tu me tog bkram par gyis ②shig /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags chos ston cing chos kyi khri la 'dug pa la yang gtor cig ces smras nas/ des de la lha'i me tog man dā ra ba lha'i khal stong byin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus me tog de dag blangs te/ me tog kha cig gis ni sa phyogs der me tog bkram pa dubyas so/ /me tog kha cig gis ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la gtor to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ①chen po chos 'phags lo bdun 'das pa dang ting nge 'dzin de las langs te/ chos kyi stan gang na yod pa 0der 'ongs nas stan bting ⑦ba la 'dug ste/ 'khor brgya stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags mthong ma thag tu 'di lta ste/ dper na bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par zhugs pa'i dge slong rtse gcig tu yid la byed pa bzhin du bde ba de lta bu thob bo/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 33—677

ston pa ni 'di yin te/ 'di lta ste chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad dben pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dben pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad g.yo ba med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa g.yo ba med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad rlom pa ①med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rlom pa ②med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad khengs pa med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khengs pa med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad ro gcig pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ro gcig pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad skye ba med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa skye ba med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad 'gag pa med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'gag pa med pa nyid do/ /nam mkha' mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /rgya mtsho mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /ri rab sna tshogs pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sna tshogs pa nyid do/ /nam mkha' rtog pa med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtog ②pa med pa nyid do/ /gzugs mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /sa'i khams mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /de bzhin du chu'i khams dang /me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu 33—678

phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /nam mkha'i khams mu med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams mu med pa nyid pas shes rab ①kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med pa nyid do/ /rdo rje lta bu'i chos mnyam pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mnyam pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad ma 'dres pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma 'dres pa nyid do / /chos thams cad dmigs su med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dmigs su med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad rnam par 'jig pa mnyam pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par 'jig pa mnyam pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad byed pa med pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa byed pa med pa nyid do/ /chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid du rig ②par bya'o zhes bya ba yin no//de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu de ltar 'dug bzhin du de'i tshe chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po skyes par gyur to/ /chos thams cad dben pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /chos thams cad g.yo ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad rlom pa ②med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad khengs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad ro gcig pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad skye ba med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /chos thams cad 'gag pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nam mkha' mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rgya mtsho mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting 33—679

nge 'dzin dang / ri rab sna tshogs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nam mkha' rtog pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / gzugs mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / de bzhin du tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed rnams dang rnam par shes pa mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / sa'i khams mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / de bzhin du chu'i khams dang me'i khams dang rlung gi khams mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / nam mkha'i khams mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams mu med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rdo rje lta bu zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad ma 'dres pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /chos thams cad dmigs su med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad rnam par 'jig pa mnyam pa nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang /chos thams cad byed pa med pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ①ba'i ting nge 'dzin te②/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus de lta bu la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya stong phrag drug cu rab tu thob par gyur to/ /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa las chos 'phags kyi le'u zhes bya ste sum cu rtsa gcig pa'o// //rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya stong phrag drug cu thob ma thag tu/ shar phyogs dang lho phyogs dang nub phyogs dang byang phyogs dang mtshams dang 'og dang steng gi phyogs dang 33—680

phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis yongs su bskor cing byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis mdun du byas te tshul 'di lta bu nyid dang ming 'di nyid dang yi ge 'di nyid kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'chad pa mthong ngo / /'di lta ste dper na/ da ltar nga stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na chos ston pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis yongs su bskor cing / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis mdun du byas te tshul 'di nyid dang ming 'di nyid dang yi ge 'di nyid kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'chad pa ①bzhin no//de mang du thos pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang thos pa rgya mtsho dang ldan par gyur ②te/gar skyes pa thams cad du yang nam yang sangs rgyas dang bral bar ma gyur to/ /skye ba thams cad du yang gang dang gang du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mngon sum du 'gyur ba de dang de dag tu skyes te/ tha na mi lam na yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /des mi khom pa thams cad ni spangs dal ba phun sum tshogs pa ni bsgrubs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo rnam grangs 'dis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sgrub pa yin par rig par bya'o/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par 'dod pa dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyad par bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 33—681

'di mnyan par bya gzung bar bya bcang bar bya klag ①par bya/ kun chub par bya rab tu gdon ②par bya bstan par bya nye bar bstan par bya/ lung dbog ⑧par bya kha ton du bya bri bar bya de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs 0kyis glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te/ me tog dang bdug pa dang dri dang / phreng ba dang byug pa dang / phye ma dang rol mo dang ⑤/ na bza' dang gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang / ba dan dang kho ra khor ⑤yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang mchod pa rnam pa mang posal/bkur ster bya bla mar bya rjed par bya mchod par bya ri mor bya bsnyen bkur bya ste kun dga' bo 'di ni nga'i rjes su bstan pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo 'di ji snyam du sems de bzhin gshegs pa khyod kyi ston pa yin nam/ kun dga' bos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi ston pa lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdag gi ston pa lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyi ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa la kun dga' bo khyod kyis lus kyi las byams pa yid du 'ong ba dang ngag gi las byams pa yid du 'ong ba dang yid kyi las byams pa yid du 'ong bas rim gror byas te/ de lta bas na kun dga' bo da ltar nga bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes sa pa'i sku 'di la ci ltar khyod kyis dga' ba dang dang ba dang ⑨dad pa dang ri mor byas pa kun dga' bo de ltar nga 'das nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la yang byos shig /kun dga' bo ci nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 33—682

'di nub par mi 'gyur zhing ci nas khyod skyes bu tha mar mi 'gyur bar ①kun dga' bo khyod la lan gnyis lan gsum du yongs su gtad do ②rjes su yongs su gtad do②/ /kun dga' bo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'jig rten na ci srid du rab tu spyod pa de srid du de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs par rig par bya'o / /kun dga' bo de srid du de bzhin gshegs pa chos ston par rig par bya'ol/ /kun dga' bo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyan pa dang 'dzin pa dang 'chang ba dang klog pa dang kun chub par byed pa dang / rab tu gdon ①pa dang ston pa dang nye bar ston ⑤pa dang lung 'bogs pa dang kha ton ⑥byed pa dang yi ger 'bri ⑦ba dang / me tog dang bdug ⑧pa dang dri dang phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dang na bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan dag dang khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang mchod pa rnam pa mang po dag gis/ bkur ster byed bla mar byed rjed par byed mchod par byed ri mor byed bsnyen bkur byed pa'i sems can de dag ni sangs rgyas mthong ba dang dam pa'i chos nyan pa dang dge 'dun la rim gro byed pa dang ma bral bar rig par bya'o//kun dga' bo sems can de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung na spyod ⑨par rig par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dgyes shing de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa dang tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor dang tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te⑩/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa 33—683

las yongs su gtad ①pa'i le'u zhes bya ste sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa rdzogs sol// // borgya gar gyi mkhan po shākya se na dang tshwa na sirnyi dang zhu chen gyi lotstsha ①ba ban de dharma tā shī dul la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab⑤/ slad kyis dbang phyug dam pa'i mnga' bdag bod kyi dpal lha btsan po bkra shis lha sde dubatsan gyi bkas/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su bhā ṣi ⑦ta dang / sgra bsgyur ⑤gyi lotstsha ⑨ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos 'grel pa dang mthun par bsgyur/ slad kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇḍi ta chen po dri paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / zhu chen gyi lotstsha ⑩ba ⑪dge slong rin chen bzang pos yul dbus kyi 'grel pa tsodang gtugs nas bcos shing zhus te gtan la phabatso/ yang 8slad kyis kyi 0smad gnye thang na mo cher/ paṇḍi ta chen po dri paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / lotstsha ⑩ba 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas gnyis kyis brgyad stong pa bshad pa'i dus su che long zhig ⑩gtan la phabatso/ phyis ⑩ra sgreng ( nye gtsug lag khang du lotstsha ba 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis 0rgya gar gyi mdo gsum dang gtugs nas dulan gnyis gtan la phabadu/ slad kyis yang lotstsha ba de nyid kyis ④bshad pa mdzad cing phran tshegs kyang gtan la phabatso/ dus phyis lotstsha bub chen po shākya'i dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis kha che'i dpe dang yul dbus kyi dpe du ma bsags 0nas gtan la phabadu// //za0033—684
